status: PROPOSED source-bound curation ledger and transparent accounting. NEW SIBLING of CORRECTED-A, CORRECTED-B and CORRECTED-C. It supersedes nothing, replaces nothing and re-runs nothing. It is NOT scientific acceptance of any component, any row or any manuscript claim.

confirmation_status.note: Only job 1's arithmetic was ever independently re-derived. Job 2 (identity/selection/overlap) and job 3 (arm attribution) were NEVER independently confirmed. The 552-key spine itself, and the disease and phase attributions attached to it, are inherited from that unconfirmed chain. Nothing in this integration confirms them; CORRECTED-A, -B and -C each say the same, and this ledger repeats it per row rather than only in prose.

grains_and_the_join.problem: The three components DO NOT SHARE ONE GRAIN. Any single-table result is therefore a stated join, never an implicit one.

CORRECTED_C.scope: the same 552 records as A, but keyed by TITLE STRINGS; C carries no om_index and no results-group id

CORRECTED_B.scope: every results-group observation in 4,235 results-bearing trials whose measure title matches job 2's response-title regex — a much larger and differently bounded corpus

A_to_C_bridge.status: DERIVED BRIDGE, verified, not declared by either component
A_to_C_bridge.verification: check I2: multiplicity 1 on both sides, symmetric difference 0, so the bridge is a bijection over all 552 rows; check I2b: C's evaluable_n key component equals A's carried job-1 value on 552/552
A_to_C_bridge.hazard: the bridge is a string key. It happens to be unique here; it is NOT a general-purpose key, and any future record with a repeated (nct, om_title, group_title) would break it. The check would fail rather than silently pick one.

A_to_B_bridge.key: obs_id constructed from A's own (nct, om_index, group_id)
A_to_B_bridge.status: PARTIAL BY CONSTRUCTION — 458 of 552 join; 94 do not

non_join_states.TRIAL_OUTSIDE_B_CORPUS_SCOPE: 48 rows in 21 trials: the trial does not appear in B's ledger at all
non_join_states.MEASURE_OUTSIDE_B_TITLE_BOUNDARY: 46 rows in 17 trials: the trial is in B, the outcome measure is not — job 2's response-title regex does not match it

A_to_B_bridge.rule: The 94 are NEVER inner-joined away. They stay in the spine with b_join_state recorded and a B_NOT_ASSESSED blocking condition. Conversely the 15,658 B observations with no A/C counterpart are emitted in COVERAGE-b-observations.tsv rather than dropped.

grains_and_the_join.known_hazard_carried_from_both_A_and_B: The 8 delivered leaf TSVs are schema-incompatible as delivered (4 distinct headers in QB, 4 in QC; B check C16b). B harmonised them under a recorded mapping; this integration consumes B's harmonised output and does not re-harmonise.

LEDGER-integrated-552.tsv.grain: one row per spine record (A's 552 keys)
LEDGER-integrated-552.tsv.rule: a_* columns are CORRECTED-A verbatim, c_* are CORRECTED-C verbatim, b_* are CORRECTED-B verbatim. No component's value is ever rewritten by another's (check I5).

COVERAGE-b-observations.tsv.grain: one row per CORRECTED-B response observation
COVERAGE-b-observations.tsv.rule: the 15,658 records that exist in B and in neither A nor C are marked B_ONLY__NO_DENOMINATOR_CATEGORY_OR_ARM_COMPONENT. They are neither resolved nor excluded here.

DISPOSITION-MAP.tsv.rule: every A row (552), every C row (552) and every B observation (16,116) appears exactly once, plus the 94 spine rows B never assessed (check I9).

CONTRADICTIONS.tsv.grain: one row per (spine row, contradiction code)

INTEGRATION-CENSUS.json.rule: every count recomputed from the emitted tables by check I13, not asserted.

INTEGRATION-CHECKS.json.rule: machine record of the 16 checks; check_integration.py exits 1 if any fails.

integration_state.BLOCKED: at least one component holds a component-specific blocking condition for this record (447 rows).
integration_state.NO_COMPONENT_BLOCK_FOUND__NOT_AN_ELIGIBI: no component-specific block was found (105 rows). This is the ABSENCE of a found defect, not a grant. Every one of these rows still carries B_DISJOINTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE_NO_PARTICIPANT_FLOW, still sits on the unconfirmed job2/job3 chain, and still has no approved rule for choosing among competing records.

blocking_conditions.C_ARM_LINK_NOT_CONFIRMED:<state>: CORRECTED-C did not confirm the arm link (CONFIRMED_TYPE_ONLY 26, CANDIDATE 10, UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE 8, UNRESOLVED 5).
blocking_conditions.C_CONTROL_STATUS_CONTESTED: the group's own record says placebo/no-intervention while the confirmed registry arm is typed non-control (5). Neither field wins.
blocking_conditions.C_CONTROL_STATUS_UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE: control status not determinable from this cache (25). NEVER read as not-control.
blocking_conditions.C_CONTROL_STATUS_CANDIDATE_ONLY: control claimed by group text only, no confirmed registry link (1).
blocking_conditions.B_COMPETING_RECORDS_UNRESOLVED: the row's B cohort key holds more than one competing observation and no selection rule is approved (309).
blocking_conditions.B_NOT_ASSESSED:<state>: the row is outside B's corpus or title boundary, so identity, repetition and overlap were never assessed for it (94).
blocking_conditions.B_OBSERVATION_NOT_USABLE_FOR_PROPORTION: B marked the joined observation unusable (0 rows — a finding, not an assumption).
blocking_conditions.B_DISJOINTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE_NO_PARTICIPA: UNIVERSAL, on all 552 rows: the cache carries no participantFlowModule, so no two cohorts can be shown to be distinct patient sets.

contradictions_retained.A_UNSUITABLE_WHILE_C_ARM_CONFIRMED: 60 rows. A's doubt about the denominator/category structure and C's confidence in the arm link are BOTH true statements about different things. Neither is allowed to cancel the other; the row stays BLOCKED (check I6).
contradictions_retained.A_NOT_REFUTED_WHILE_C_ARM_<state>: 48 rows. A found no blocking defect; C could not confirm the arm. Both stand.
contradictions_retained.A_NOT_REFUTED_WHILE_B_SET_UNRESOLVED: 270 rows. A found no blocking defect; B holds competing records for the same cohort with no approved way to choose.
contradictions_retained.A_B_DENOMINATOR_VALUE_DISAGREE: 0 rows — A's read denominator and B's independently read denominator agree on all 458 joined rows.
contradictions_retained.C_SOLE_ARM_BUT_MULTIPLE_RESULTS_GROUPS: 83 rows where the trial registers one arm but the measure reports several results groups — the record's own contradiction of a one-arm reading.
contradictions_retained.ROW_NOT_ASSESSED_BY_B: 94 rows: a coverage gap, recorded as such and not as agreement.

fences.derived_here: NOTHING beyond curation states. rate_derived, unique_patient_total_derived and control_comparison_derived are the literal NOT_DERIVED on 552/552 rows, and check I7 fails if any forbidden-named column ever holds another value.
fences.manuscript_status: The endpoint manuscript stays PARKED. It was not read and not edited by this integration.
